positive_snippets: Had a great stay at Fab Hotel Floyd! Special thanks to Kajal at the reception — she was extremely courteous, helpful, and made our check-in and stay experience really smooth. Truly appreciated her warm hospitality!

I went to ( Hotel floyd stay ) with my family, and it gave us excellent family-friendly services. The staff was amiable and consistently made sure I was comfortable. I will stay there when I come back!
Very decent hotel.  Workers are quite cooperative and helpful. As per price , the hotel is good and decently located
negative_snippets: Totally disappointed. The room was not at all clean, completely opposite shown in pictures, there were bugs in bed, foul smell, open gutters in toilet and not at all clean. The toilet were so bad we could not even take bath. The staff boy was cooperative though. But overall it was too bad.

The room was not clean no basic things which were shown in the pictures provided. Room was not similar to what it was shown in the pictures.
And I also found condoms in the room drawer then I asked them to change the room. I went there with my parents and it was the worst experience.
